high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website wired.com, viewed on a mobile device. The time displayed at the top of the screen is 8:08, and the device is connected to a 5G network with a partially charged battery. The article discusses the impact of Steve Jobs' Stanford commencement speech and its influence on public figures. The text highlights how Jobs lived according to his own advice and pursued what he loved, leading to the creation of legendary products. It emphasizes that while his gadgets were life-changing, none had as profound an emotional impact as the Stanford speech.
